'''menace64 Just one of those goody-good LS decks....''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''GPN category:''' Standard

== Strategy ==

Never start with Obi-Wan's Hut! This would ruin all of my deck's strategy. My basic strategy with my light side is to get a droid on the Yavin 4: Massassi War Room the quickest I can, so that I can play a How Did We Get Into This Mess? I really love this card. A lot of strategy comes with it.
